what: The first real Linux ARM64 source hello exited 125 after six seconds because the launcher unconditionally refused a program native library. The CLI and retained services had built, five binaries were sealed, and the canonical shelf pin had passed strict verification.
cost: The cold phase prevented every subsequent source CLI smoke phase and production acceptance from running.
cause: The ELF producer, descriptor reader and Linux dlopen driver existed, but run-mode integration and native constructor invocation remained guarded as unimplemented. Real native-load tests were restricted to macOS ARM64, so format tests did not exercise the missing Linux start path.
whys: A source program that needs its native image reaches a Linux NotBuilt branch before Down::Native is read.
Removing that branch alone would expose another NotBuilt branch for nonempty initializer lists.
The existing initializer-error return could also leave the control thread running during a scoped join.
class: a platform's native record producer and reader exist without an executed launcher contract
prevention: Complete the existing shared-object path with one owned process-argument view, binding before ordered constructors, and explicit control-thread shutdown on refusal. Exercise real generated ELF images through DlNatives on Linux ARM64, retain named failures and the source smoke, and refuse TLS templates with post-load Rust-pointer patches until those pointers can be bound before TLS copies are made.
workaround: None. The native-image requirement and smoke failure remain visible until the implementation executes successfully.
fix: Implemented the shared-object startup path, process-owned constructor/main arguments and libc environment alias, stop/join on initializer refusal, and loader-metadata validation that refuses Rust pointer cells in TLS. At tree 57c5ea0b381a9e0ecdf1cd86953f45db76ebb86f all seven real Linux native-load tests, five load-core tests and new argument/atexit/cleanup controls passed; the release source CLI then passed cold, warm and edited hello runs. Three existing stub tests exposed independent process-wide wait-driver initialization, recorded in native-test-wait-driver-20261124. The remaining source smoke stopped on the stale invalid-diagnostic matcher recorded in source-check-diagnostic-schema-20261124; later phases and the final exact-tree replay remain required.
